Crisp meticulous tapered engraved fur strokes, airy crosshatching and varied restrained shading following anatomy; open mint highlights, clear eyes and whiskers, short fur distinct from curls, scruffy coat and long fur. Natural interspersed sizes in the exact order above, ALL SEVEN seated and gazing toward the viewer.
